title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Tracking Cash Flow Without the Overwhelm

questions.text: According to the narration, what is a cash leak?
options: Money spent on things you love like Carnival fete.
Untracked money disappearing on impulse purchases that do not bring real value or align with your goals.
questions.explanation: The narration defines a cash leak as untracked money disappearing on impulse purchases that do not bring real value or align with your goals, distinguishing it from spending on things you love.

questions.text: True or false: The recommended weekly tracking routine takes about ten minutes once a week, typically on a Sunday evening.
questions.explanation: The narration states that all you need is ten minutes once a week, usually on a Sunday evening, to review where your dollars went.
